<h1>QIRT 2026 Conference — Naples, Italy</h1>

<p>The <strong>17th International Conference on Quantitative InfraRed Thermography (QIRT 2026)</strong> has been announced. The conference will take place from June 29 to July 3, 2026, in Naples, Italy.</p>

<p>QIRT is one of the premier conferences for the infrared thermography and thermal measurement community, covering topics including:</p>

<ul>
<li>Non-destructive testing and evaluation</li>
<li>Thermophysical property measurement</li>
<li>Building diagnostics</li>
<li>Biomedical applications</li>
<li>Industrial process monitoring</li>
</ul>
